entities.summary: Herman Feshbach was an American physicist. He was an Institute Professor Emeritus of physics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Feshbach is best known for Feshbach resonance and for writing, with Philip M. Morse, Methods of Theoretical Physics.
